description: This file defines the ReadableCategory class, which extends CategoryEntity and implements Serializable. It manages category-related data such as description, parent category, and product count, serving as a data transfer object within the web application's catalog module.

classes.name: ReadableCategory
classes.description: A class representing a read-only view of a category, including description, parent category, and product count.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Returns the number of products in this category.

methods.name: setProductCount
methods.description: Sets the number of products in this category.
